notes.title: Retiring Simple Clicker
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I wanted to let everyone currently playing and anyone who stumbles on the steam page  that I’ll be retiring this game from Steam. With my work schedule the past couple months, I don’t have the time to properly support or update it the way it deserves. Rather than leave it sitting around without attention, I think it’s best to let it go.[/p][p]This was a fun project for me to work on, and I really appreciate anyone who took the time to play, and provide feedback through the community hub or left a review.[/p][p]Thanks again, and hopefully I’ll be back with something new in the future when I have more time to dedicate.[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix #1 : 3/29/2025
notes.content:
[b]Addressed one of the main complaints about the game[/b]

- Fixed issue with materials starting with a negative value, making it impossible to make money unless you close and re-open the game.

-  updated help guide and tooltips to better explain the controls and mechanisms
